However, significant structural artifacts exist that were underweighted in the initial assessment. While the main subjects are recognizable, these grounding failures and potential limb distortions represent more than minor texture anomalies. The initial score of 4.2 was too lenient given the severity of the pose auditor's warning and the visible fusion artifacts at the contact points.
